title: iPSCs to NGN2 Neurons
author: Elena Coccia
materials: Transition media to Neurobasal N2B27 with specific supplements.

steps.title: Transfect iPSCs with PiggyBac
steps.instruction: Transfect iPSCs with PiggyBac plasmids using Lipofectamine Stem Transfection Reagent.

steps.title: Seed iPSCs on Geltrex
steps.instruction: Dissociate iPSCs and seed at 104,000 cells per cm² onto Geltrex™-coated plates in StemFlex™ media supplemented with 10 µM Y27632 and 5 µg/mL doxycycline.

steps.title: Replace media day 1
steps.instruction: On day 1, replace the medium with Neurobasal N2B27 containing 10 µM SB431542, 100 nM LDN193189, 5 µg/mL doxycycline, and 5 µg/mL puromycin.

steps.title: Daily media change days 3‑6
steps.instruction: From days 3 to 6, change the medium daily with Neurobasal N2B27 supplemented with 1 µg/mL puromycin and 5 µg/mL doxycycline.

steps.title: Ara‑C treatment and harvest
steps.instruction: Treat cells on day 6 with Ara‑C, incubate, then dissociate for co‑culture.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 µM Ara‑C to the culture and incubate for 24 hours.
After incubation, dissociate cells using Accutase and collect for co‑culture.
